observed: d11/dusk: Hrill questioned Serevan persecution and called it unfair/dishonourable. Stated desire to control both approaches and remove Serevan by withholding hospice aid; no invented charge, crime by Serevan or relic disclosure. Await Hrill reply; no duel challenge assumed.

d11/dusk: Hrill added conditional promise to escort Serevan to reeve if no fair resolution. Answered within same concession: exclusion withdrawn and voluntary rent; asked which injury requires redress. No threat of violence or new test.

d11/dusk: Hrill named Serevan allegation about taken burial item. Admitted men brought burial standard from dig and opened chest for identification. Did not disclose buyer, letter or concede ownership.
d11/dusk: Hrill won restitution negotiation52/55vs42/65 bothsuccess. Released standard unconditionally, asked him convey voluntary rental offer independently. Sale abandoned, gains must stand.

d13/night: Hrill offered extra sword for roadwork. Explained payroll burden, offered1GP for tomorrow's lease handover/lookout setup alongside Cessa, awaiting answer.

actor_notes: LOOKS: tall weathered knight, neatly repaired mail and a plain red cloak. CORE: order belongs to whoever has the nerve to impose it. NATURE: energetic, courteous, enjoys practical accomplishments and competent company. WOUND: royal employers discarded his service when peace made it inconvenient. WANTS: a permanent command and recognition. PRESSURE: turns bargains into tests of obedience, then force. KEY: confident soldierly brevity, makes tangible offers.
